title: File Upload Policy Compiler
description: Compiles the file upload security policy. Enforces: no public-read as default storage ACL, dangerous file extensions blocked, malware scanning declared before files are accessible.

error_codes.FU001: file-upload-spec.json missing or invalid — required fields: allowedExtensions[], maxSizeBytes, storageAcl, malwareScan
error_codes.FU002: Default storage ACL is public-read — uploads must be private until explicitly shared
error_codes.FU003: Dangerous file extensions not blocked — must deny: .exe, .sh, .bat, .cmd, .ps1, .php, .phar, .jar, .py scripts
error_codes.FU004: Malware scan not declared in upload pipeline — files must be scanned before being made accessible to other users
error_codes.FU006: Upload surface missing server-side MIME type validation — allowed_mime_types[] must be declared and checked server-side, not inferred from file extension
